title: Definite Integral Substitution with Transformed Limits
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_0^1 x sqrt(1 - x^2) dx by transforming the integration limits.

steps.title: Define u and Compute Transformed Limits
steps.mathExpression: u = 1 - x^2 \implies du = -2x \, dx \implies x \, dx = -\frac{1}{2} du; \quad x = 0 \implies u = 1, \; x = 1 \implies u = 0
steps.explanation: Calculate u-values corresponding to x = 0 and x = 1.

steps.title: Rewrite Integral and Reverse Limits
steps.explanation: Absorb negative sign by swapping limits from [1, 0] to [0, 1].
